# 定义清理文本的正则表达式
def clean_text(text):
    # 删除空格、换行符等
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', '', text)
    return text

# 抽取重要词汇
def extract_keywords(text, keyword_list):
    words = text.split()
    return [word for word in words if word in keyword_list]

# 抽取向量
def extract_vectors(text, word_embeddings):
    words = text.split()
    vectors = [word_embeddings.get(word, np.zeros(300)) for word in words]
    return np.array(vectors)

# 清理和预处理文本
def process_text(text, keyword_list, word_embeddings):
    text = clean_text(text)
    keywords = extract_keywords(text, keyword_list)
    vectors = extract_vectors(keywords, word_embeddings)
    return vectors, keywords

# 构建句子的嵌入向量
def build_sentence_embedding(data, keyword_list, word_embeddings):
    sentence_embeddings = []
    for text in data:
        vectors, _ = process_text(text, keyword_list, word_embeddings)
        # 使用平均值来获取句子的嵌入向量
        if len(vectors) > 0:
            sentence_embedding = np.mean(vectors, axis=0)
        else:
            sentence_embedding = np.zeros(300)
        sentence_embeddings.append(sentence_embedding)
